notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Stasis builds. Recurrent Impact is a rapid fire LMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "good damage profile but mediocre total damage and worst recoil of any LMG frame". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and loose so you could improve recoil control or look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are the best available. Recurrent Impact can be used for add clear with Stasis builds, perhaps supporting a double special loadout. For that, Field Prep in the first trait perk column grants +55 Reload Speed with a ×0.8 animation scalar to both reload and ready/stow when crouched, and bumps Ammo Generation by +40, which together with a Bandolier or Abundant Ammo mod pushes Ammo Generation to 80 or more. In the second column, Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill - these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc Stasis subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. Aegis ranks the Land Tank origin trait as S-Tier - it's strong for PvE, stacking up to ×3 on kills to provide +10 to your Health stat and a max ×0.85 damage resistance for 5s. If you're interested, the name doubles as a literal description of its rapid-fire function and a subtle nod to the psychological trauma of mind-altering psionic manipulation central to its narrative debut in Season of the Risen. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Having a huge magazine and access to firing line gives some wonderful damage but you really have to crank straight down on your input method of choice to hit constant crits. Without arrowhead brake you best hope you see yellow because a recoil direction of 53 is pitifully low. You could also opt for a room clearing weapon through subsistence and headstone, but I would just rather have Eyasluna for that. Even Syncopation-55 is better than this bullet hose." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "PvP is a wash, you need to control the recoil so heavily while also maintaining crits on a moving stompee jumping, icarus-dashing, overshielded, invisible dood with the latest gaming chair. I’d rather not use this machine gun for that purpose thank you." Recommended MW: Range.
